section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports findings from a single study examining the relationship between body appreciation and various predictor variables. Body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with BMI (rs -.17 to -.26), and a multiple linear regression analysis (F(7, 134) = 3.09, p = .005) identified Stereotypic Images and Activities and BMI as significant predictors of body appreciation. The study appears to involve approximately 142 participants based on the reported degrees of freedom.
